result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. I found 2 issues: a spelling error in the search placeholder and a rendering artifact in the promo banner's bottom-right corner. Partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are excluded as intended behavior.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'. 'Restaurants' is misspelled in the app's most prominent input field.
issues.suggestion: Change the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and add spell-checking to UI string reviews.

issues.description: In the green '3 free deliveries for you' banner, a dark green sliver appears at the bottom-right corner. The decorative circle does not seem to be clipped by the banner's rounded corners, so it breaks the corner shape.
issues.suggestion: Set overflow: hidden (or the platform equivalent, such as clipToOutline or clipShape) on the banner container so the decorative circles are clipped to its border radius.
